Razorfen Downs are the ancestral burial grounds of the quilboar, nestled amid huge brambles in the Barrens, on the east side of the far southern edge. The Scourge have taken over much of the downs, and infest the burial grounds with the reawakened dead. It is also known as RFD, not to be confused with RFK or BFD.

Razor Hill is an orcish settlement built on a crossroads in central Durotar. The southern road eventually leads to Sen'jin Village and the Valley of Trials. The northern road leads to Orgrimmar, and the road west (now largely washed out by the Southfury Watershed) leads across the Southfury River to the Northern Barrens and eventually to the major Horde gathering point of the Crossroads. The Razor Hill Barracks is the single most prominent structure in the town. The town also has a burrow. Orgnil Soulscar is occupied with investigating the activities of the Burning Blade in the area. During the Darkspear Rebellion, Vol'jin captured the town from the Kor'kron and was using it to plan his atta

Razorfen Kraul is the ancestral home of the quilboar, heavily entrenched within the thorns that supposedly sprang from the corpse of the demigod Agamaggan. It is found in the Southern Barrens, at the far southern edge, west side.

The Razormane tribe is a tribe of quilboar that inhabit Durotar and the Barrens. The Razormane led by Nak, Kuz and Lok Orcbane have been known to raid the Crossroads and steal supplies. They were at war with the Bristleback quilboars. At some point in the past, when the mysterious kelani magi fell, the Razormane quilboar were quick to scavenge their Enchanted Gemstones. When the Cataclysm split the Barrens, the Razormanes were thrown into chaos. The northern group became refugees separated from their leadership, until they rallied under Tortusk, who turned them into brigands and had them attack Grol'dom Farm. After his death, the orcs thought about starting a dialogue with the survivors.

Reading is the act of using certain items with some sort of text on them. This includes books (in-game books and training manuals), quest items with text, or scrolls. Books and items that can be read can be right-clicked to bring up the text.
Razzashi Raptor is a raptor found in Zul'Gurub. It can be tamed by a hunter.

Razorwind Canyon is a nesting ground for the Dustwind harpies of Durotar. It is located in two areas, to the east and west of the main road leading between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar. There are entrances to it by taking paths right or left from that road just north of Razor Hill, or by the going to the north exit of that canyon and checking to the immediate right. Two other entrances from the west are near Tor'kren Farm and by the Southfury Watershed. An entrance to Drygulch Ravine is located in the eastern section of the canyon, through a cave . The Razorfen tribe is a tribe of quilboar led by Charlga Razorflank. The tribe controls both Razorfen Kraul and the Razorfen Downs where Agamaggan died. The quilboar are believed to be the offspring of Agamaggan. Razorfen Kraul was conquered by Charlga Razorflank, who is now living deep inside. Within their lair they amassed their forces, threatening the land. The Razorfen tribe has driven the tauren away from southern Barrens. The quilboar managed to capture Willix the Importer, Henrig Lonebrow and Heralath Fallowbrook. As stated by Charlga Razorflank, their "New allies will avenge us". The Razorfen seemed to have befriended the Scourge in the Razorfen Downs, but the Scourge took them over,
Razzashi Broodwidows are spiders found in Zul'Gurub. When tamed by a hunter it teaches Bite Rank 8. Bite Rank 8 will require 25 points to train your other pets.

Razor Hill Grunts are orc guards located in the town of Razor Hill in Durotar. They are stationed at the town entrance/exits, structures and patrol the streets. They are simple grunts that serve to protect Razor Hill citizens from the dangers in the environment such as boars and snakes as well as crush any sailors or marines that decide to launch an attack on Razor Hill from the Alliance fortress of Tiragarde Keep. They can provide directions to various locations.

The Razor Hill Barracks features trainers for warriors, priests, shamans and first aid. It also has a general goods vendor. The barracks is the largest building in Razor Hill, and marks it as one of the main settlements in Durotar (excluding Orgrimmar).

Razzle Sprysprocket is a gnome quest giver located in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. When Lazlo Grindwidget moved to Kharanos, Razzle scoffed at him. When a giant Frostmane troll attacked the town, Razzle and Ozzie Togglevolt‎ tried to throw grenades at the troll however, they found out that the grenades were in fact time bombs. The troll overwhelmed them. Lazlo was able to defeat the troll, thus Razzle and Ozzie apologized to Lazlo and offered him a temporary place in their shop. He was present during the Legion Invasions, fighting the demons.

The Reagent Bank is a 98-slot tab on the bank window which stores only crafting reagents. The Reagent Bank can be unlocked for . A reagent bag is type of bag which can only contain reagents, so long as the reagent is listed as such in the description of the item's tooltip. Its bag slot is the last item to the left of the backpack with a silver ring. It cannot be collapsed with the rest of the bag slots and it can only contain reagent bags, while profession bags can only be slotted in the gold ring slots. Having a reagent bag and a profession bag equipped will prioritize the former even if the reagents is related to the profession. There are currently seven total reagent bags available: *Deviate Scale Pouch *Henry's Handbag (item) *Convenient Crate *Storm-Battered Reagent Bag *Gatherer's Reagent Pouch *Simply Stitched
